roots.origin: 拉丁语 cadere（落下、掉下来），过去分词 casus；incidere（in＋cadere）本义是「落到某处上头」，引申为事情落下来发生
roots.core_concept: to fall upon, to come down on something / 落到某处上头
roots.core_image: 一颗东西从高处掉下来，正砸在路当中

roots.origin: 希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮子）经拉丁语 cyclus 入英语；轮子转一整圈回到原处，是这一族的共同意象
roots.core_concept: a wheel coming round to where it began / 转一圈又回到起点的轮
roots.core_image: 轮子滚过一整圈，气门嘴又回到贴地那一点

roots.origin: 拉丁语 largus（丰足的、宽绰的），本义偏「给得出、有余裕」，英语 large 早期也表「宽绰」，后才专指体量
roots.core_concept: having room and to spare / 宽绰有余、装得下还有空
roots.core_image: 一只箱子装完东西还空着半截，盖子轻轻就合上

roots.origin: 拉丁语 maior（更大的，magnus 的比较级）；maiestas（尊大、威仪）由此出，英语 major/majority/majesty 同循此路
roots.core_concept: the greater of what is compared / 相比之下更大的那一方
roots.core_image: 一棵树上最粗那根枝，别的枝都从它分出去

roots.origin: 拉丁语 numerus（数目、数），numerare（计数）由此出；英语 number 同源，本族收 -numer- 一支的派生词
roots.core_concept: the count that can be told off one by one / 能一个一个点数出来的数目
roots.core_image: 手指点着东西一件件数过去，嘴里跟着报数

roots.origin: 希腊语 logos（话语、道理、条理），legein（说）的名词形；-logy 作学科后缀即「关于某物的条理」。vetted 族名作 olog，那是词干提取切出的假词根：真正共用的是 logos
roots.core_concept: words that give an account of something / 把一件事说出条理来
roots.core_image: 一个人开口把事情从头理到尾，听的人跟得上

concepts.concept: to fall upon, to come down on something
concepts.core_image: 东西自高处掉下，正砸在路当中

concepts.concept: a wheel coming round to where it began
concepts.core_image: 轮子滚满一圈，气门嘴又回到贴地那一点
箱子装完还空着半截，盖子轻轻就合上

concepts.concept: the greater of what is compared
concepts.core_image: 树上最粗那根枝，别的枝都由它分出

concepts.concept: the count that can be told off one by one
concepts.core_image: 手指点着一件件数过去，嘴里跟着报数

concepts.concept: words that give an account of something
concepts.core_image: 开口把事情从头理到尾，听的人跟得上

words.root_logic: in-（落到…上）+ cid（落下）+ -ent → 落到日常里头的那一桩
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidens（落在上头的），来自 incidere ← in＋cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: an event, especially an unpleasant or unusual one
words.core_concept: the one thing that came down into an otherwise plain day – 落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.core_image: 路当中忽然砸下一样东西，行人全停下来看
examples: The incident was reported to the police.
No one was hurt in the incident.
semantic_expansions: 事件/事变：落进平常日子里的那一桩
words.recall_hint: in-（落到上）+ cid（落下）→ 落进日子里的那一桩

words.root_logic: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来的频密程度 → 发生的多寡
words.origin: 拉丁语 incidentia，来自 incidere（落到上头）
words.native_definition: the rate at which something happens, especially something unwanted
words.core_concept: how thickly such fallings come down over a stretch – 一段里头落下多密
words.core_image: 雨点打在窗台上，一阵密一阵疏，数得出快慢
examples: The incidence of the disease has fallen.
There is a high incidence of theft here.
semantic_expansions: 发生率/发生频率：这类事落下来的密度
words.recall_hint: incident（落下之事）+ -ence → 落下来有多密

words.root_logic: incidental（顺带落下的）+ -ly → 顺着话头落下来一句 → 顺便说
words.origin: 英语 incidentally，来自 incidental ← incident
words.native_definition: used to add a remark not connected to the main point
words.core_concept: a word that drops in alongside, not the thing one came to say – 顺着旁边落下来的一句，不是正题
words.core_image: 话说到一半，他顺口带出一句不相干的
examples: Incidentally, I saw her yesterday.
The two met quite incidentally.
semantic_expansions: 顺便说：顺着话头旁落下来的一句
偶然地：不是安排好、恰巧落下的
words.recall_hint: incidental（顺带落下）+ -ly → 顺着旁边落下一句

words.root_logic: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈 → 周期；也指骑那两个轮子
words.origin: 拉丁语 cyclus，来自希腊语 kyklos（圆圈、轮）
words.native_definition: a set of events repeating in the same order; to ride a bicycle
words.core_concept: one full turn that ends where it started – 转满一圈、终点又是起点
words.core_image: 四季走一遍，又回到落第一场雪的那几天
examples: The washing machine has a short cycle.
She cycles to work every day.
semantic_expansions: 周期/循环：转满一圈又回到起点
骑车：踩着轮子转圈前行
words.recall_hint: kyklos（圆圈）→ 转回原处的一整圈

words.root_logic: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）+ -e → 两个轮子的车
words.origin: 法语 bicycle，由拉丁 bi-（二）＋希腊 kyklos（轮）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: a vehicle with two wheels that one pedals
words.core_concept: the frame that rides on two turning circles – 架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.core_image: 前后两个圈一齐转起来，人就跟着往前走
examples: He rode his bicycle to school.
Her bicycle has a broken chain.
semantic_expansions: 自行车/脚踏车：架在两个转圈之物上的车
words.recall_hint: bi-（二）+ cycl（轮）→ 两个轮子的车

words.root_logic: re-（再）+ cycl（转一圈）+ -e → 让它再转一圈回来 → 回收再用
words.origin: 英语 recycle，由 re-＋cycle 合成，20 世纪随环保用语普及
words.native_definition: to treat used material so it can be used again
words.core_concept: sending a thing round the loop once more instead of dropping it – 让用过之物再走一圈回来，而不是丢掉
words.core_image: 旧瓶子送回炉里，出来时又是一只能用的
examples: We recycle paper and glass at home.
These bottles can be recycled.
semantic_expansions: 回收/再利用：让用过之物再转一圈回来
words.recall_hint: re-（再）+ cycl（转圈）→ 让它再走一圈回来

words.root_logic: largus（宽绰有余）→ 体量占得开、不局促
words.origin: 古法语 large，来自拉丁语 largus（丰足的、宽绰的）
words.native_definition: of considerable size or extent
words.core_concept: taking up room with margin left over – 占得开、周围还留着余地
words.core_image: 两臂张开也抱不住那截树身
examples: They live in a large house.
A large number of people came.
semantic_expansions: 大的/大量的：占得开、有余裕而不局促
words.recall_hint: largus（宽绰有余）→ 占得开、不局促

words.root_logic: en-（使…）+ large（宽绰）→ 使它占得更开 → 扩大、放大
words.origin: 古法语 enlargier（放宽），由 en-＋large ← 拉丁语 largus
words.native_definition: to make something bigger, or to become bigger
words.core_concept: pushing the edges out so there is more room within – 把边往外推，里头就更宽绰
words.core_image: 照片一角被拉到满幅，原先看不清的纹路露了出来
examples: They plan to enlarge the kitchen.
Please enlarge this photograph.
semantic_expansions: 扩大/放大/增大：把边往外推、使更宽绰
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ large（宽绰）→ 把边往外推

words.root_logic: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地 → 主要、多半
words.origin: 英语 largely，来自 large 加副词后缀 -ly
words.native_definition: mostly; to a great extent
words.core_concept: the side that takes up most of the whole – 占了整体大头的那一边
words.core_image: 天平一头压得低低的，另一头只剩一点
examples: The project was largely successful.
His account is largely accurate.
semantic_expansions: 主要地/大部分/多半：占着整体大头的那一边
words.recall_hint: large（大部分）+ -ly → 占着大头地

words.root_logic: maior（更大的）→ 相比之下更要紧的；名词指主修的那一门
words.origin: 拉丁语 maior（更大的），magnus（大）的比较级
words.native_definition: greater in size or importance; a student's main subject
words.core_concept: the thicker branch the others hang off – 别的枝都挂在它上头的那一根
words.core_image: 顺着树身往上看，最粗那根撑住了大半个树冠
examples: This is a major problem for us.
She chose history as her major.
semantic_expansions: 主要的/重大的：相比之下更大更要紧的那一方
专业：所修各门里作主干的那一门
words.recall_hint: maior（更大的）→ 别的都挂在它上头的那一根

words.root_logic: major（更大的）+ -ity → 更大的那一部分 → 多数
words.origin: 法语 majorité，来自中世纪拉丁语 maioritas ← maior
words.native_definition: the greater number or part of a group
words.core_concept: the side that has the greater count – 数下来更多的那一边
words.core_image: 举手一数，一边的手明显比另一边密
examples: The majority voted in favour.
A majority of students agreed.
semantic_expansions: 大多数/多数：数下来更多的那一边
words.recall_hint: major（更大的）+ -ity → 数下来更多那一边

words.root_logic: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派；亦作君主尊称
words.origin: 古法语 majeste，来自拉丁语 maiestas（威严、尊大）← maior
words.native_definition: impressive dignity or grandeur; a title for a king or queen
words.core_concept: the bearing of one seated higher than all present – 坐得比在场所有人都高的那份气派
words.core_image: 台阶尽头那个座位高出一截，底下的人都得抬头看
examples: The mountains rose in silent majesty.
Her Majesty will arrive at noon.
semantic_expansions: 威严/壮丽：令人须仰视的那份气派
陛下：以此气派作君主的尊称
words.recall_hint: maior（更大）→ maiestas（尊大）→ 令人仰视的气派

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的
words.origin: 拉丁语 numerosus（数目多的），来自 numerus（数目）
words.native_definition: existing in great numbers; many
words.core_concept: so many that the counting runs long – 点起来要数好一阵
words.core_image: 屋檐下的燕子一排接一排，数到后头就乱了
examples: She has numerous friends abroad.
We met on numerous occasions.
semantic_expansions: 许多的/众多的：数目多、点起来要数好一阵
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ous（多…的）→ 数目多的

words.root_logic: numer（数目）+ -ical（…的）→ 用数目表示的、按数计的
words.origin: 英语 numerical，来自中世纪拉丁语 numericus ← numerus
words.native_definition: expressed in numbers; relating to numbers
words.core_concept: set down as counts rather than words – 记成数目而非文字
words.core_image: 表格里每一栏都换成了阿拉伯记号，一列列排下去
examples: Put the files in numerical order.
The numerical results agree with theory.
semantic_expansions: 数字的/数值的：以数目记下、按数计的
words.recall_hint: numer（数目）+ -ical → 以数目记下的

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able（可…的）→ 数不过来的
words.origin: 拉丁语 innumerabilis（数不清的），来自 in-＋numerare（计数）← numerus
words.native_definition: too many to be counted
words.core_concept: more than the fingers can keep up with – 手指跟不上、点不完
words.core_image: 沙从指缝里漏下去，颗数根本跟不上
examples: He made innumerable attempts.
Innumerable stars filled the sky.
semantic_expansions: 数不清的/无数的：多到点不过来
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ numer（数）+ -able → 数不过来的

words.root_logic: apo-（离开、退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开 → 认过的说辞
words.origin: 希腊语 apologia（辩解、答辩），来自 apo（离）＋logos（话语）
words.native_definition: a statement saying one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: stepping back and putting the fault into words – 退一步，把自己的不是说出口
words.core_image: 他往后退了半步，把话头接过来，承认是自己没办好
examples: He offered a sincere apology.
She made no apology for her view.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/歉意：退一步把自己的不是说出口
辩解：同样是把话说开，为自己申说
words.recall_hint: apo-（退开）+ log（说辞）→ 退一步把话说开

words.root_logic: apology（认过的说辞）+ -ise（使、行）→ 把那番话说出来
words.origin: 希腊语 apologizesthai（申说），来自 apologia ← apo＋logos
words.native_definition: to say that one is sorry for a fault
words.core_concept: putting the stepping-back into actual words – 把那退一步的意思真说出口
words.core_image: 他站起来，当着众人把那句话讲了出来
examples: He apologised for being late.
She refused to apologise.
semantic_expansions: 道歉/认错：把退一步认过的话说出口
words.recall_hint: apology（认过说辞）+ -ise → 把那番话说出口

words.root_logic: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理、学科）→ 讲清生命之理的那门学问
words.origin: 希腊语 bios（生命）＋logos（条理）合成，19 世纪造词
words.native_definition: the scientific study of living things
words.core_concept: the account given of how living things work – 把活物的道理说清的那一套
words.core_image: 从一片叶脉讲到血液怎么走，条理一路排下来
examples: She teaches biology at the college.
Marine biology is his field.
semantic_expansions: 生物学：把活物的道理说出条理的那门学问
words.recall_hint: bio-（生命）+ -logy（条理）→ 讲清生命之理的学问

words.root_logic: positum（被放置的）→ 沿路安置的驿站 → 邮政；被安置的位子 → 职位
words.origin: 古法语 poste，来自意大利语 posta ← 拉丁语 posita/ponere（放置）；驿站本义是「沿途置马之处」。门柱义的 post 另出拉丁 postis，不在此族
words.native_definition: the system that carries letters; a job or official position
words.core_concept: a station set along the way, and by extension a place one is set in – 沿途安置的那一站，引申为人被安在的位子
words.core_image: 沿路每隔一程设一处，换马换人，信件一路递下去
examples: Send it by post, not by email.
She applied for a teaching post.
semantic_expansions: 邮政/邮件：靠沿途置站接力递送的那套
职位：人被安置进去的那个位子
words.recall_hint: positum（被放置的）→ 沿途置站 → 邮政；被安的位子 → 职位

words.root_logic: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套接力所付的钱
words.origin: 英语 postage，由 post ← 拉丁语 ponere（放置）加 -age 构成
words.native_definition: the money charged for sending something by post
words.core_concept: what one pays for the relay of stations to carry it – 为那套接力递送付的钱
words.core_image: 柜台上称过重量，贴上几枚小纸片才收下
examples: Postage costs have gone up again.
The price includes postage.
semantic_expansions: 邮费/邮资：为沿途接力递送所付的钱
words.recall_hint: post（驿站接力）+ -age（费用）→ 走这套递送付的钱

words.root_logic: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放的姿态
words.origin: 法语 posture，来自意大利语 postura ← 拉丁语 positura（安放、位置）← ponere
words.native_definition: the way a person holds their body; an attitude taken up
words.core_concept: how the body is set and held in place – 身体被摆放、端住的那个样子
words.core_image: 他把背挺直、肩往后收，整个人的架子就稳住了
examples: Good posture prevents back pain.
The country took a defensive posture.
semantic_expansions: 姿势/体态：身体摆放端住的那个样子
姿态：对外摆出的那副架势
words.recall_hint: positura（放置的样子）→ 身体摆放端住的样子
